newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: China seeks increased investment in Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: China seeks increased investment in Sri Lanka.

text.p: Sri Lanka's foreign ministry said on Friday that China wanted to increase investment and joint ventures in Sri Lanka while strengthening trade ties.
The foreign ministry issued the statement following a meeting between Chinese Vice Minister for Foreign Affairs Tang Jiaxuan and Sri Lankan Foreign Minister Lakshman Kadirgamar.

It said China also wanted to cooperate closely with the seven-nation South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC), which groups Sri Lanka, India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bhutan, the Maldives and Bangladesh.
"Both sides agreed that there should be increased Chinese investment and joint ventures in Sri Lanka...", the ministry said in a statement.
Tang is leading a seven-member delegation on a three-day visit to the Indian Ocean island. He leaves on Saturday.
